body:
Hello and welcome to Infinity's official thread.

Date of creation: February 18, 2015
Founders: PedroRiwking
Current Leaders: PedroRiwking

Here at Infinity we thoroughly believe that teamwork is vital, and success comes when good team work is achieved. In this team we will always try to have fun, we will be very competitive and strive to be the best. Our goal with this team is to be the best and have fun at all times. This team was founded by PedroRiwking.

Infinity is a clan all about fun and competitive play. Infinity is a international english speaking clan who strives for the best.This clan is built for every member to have as much fun as possible and very intense and competitive games.If you're a quitter and you don't have passion for what you do than don't bother applying as we don't like negativity in our clan.

We have incredibly high standards on who we accept and therefore we choose our members carefully.

replies.body:
IGN: Characteristics (originally known as Sunken_Library)
What should we call you: "Sunken" would be the usual but you can call me by my current IGN as well. I don't exactly mind.
Age: 15
Past Teams: None on Avicus but I have had past teams on OCN.
Pros: I'm not bad of a strategist. I like to PvP in general and I think I'm not too bad at it. Also pretty decent at quickly making defences and then expanding on it later on in the game.
Cons: Internet, ping, rushing, changing tactics in an instant and pretty much being on the offense side is scary.
Skype: Given if accepted.
Position(s): Preferably around the middle area where I can rush and defend. I like to rush in the beginning and then help out later but whatever is normally fine by me.
Describe yourself in a paragraph:
I'm an Aussie PvPer and I love to have fun. Even though I'm Aussie, I try my best to not let my Internet put me down but it's too hard at times. I'm really easygoing and friendly for the most part. I'm extremely relaxed during most circumstances and I am dedicated to whatever I put my mind on. Although, if real life situations become important, I know what I have to do.
Miscellaneous:
I also know a couple of members on your current roster from OCN and with some basic experience, I think I can definitely improve with coordinated team play.
